import pandas as pd, numpy as np, agent_api

def build(view, day):
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    prod = view.table("products")
    hh = np.asarray(view.households)
    m = tx.merge(prod[["product_id","department","brand"]], on="product_id", how="left")
    m["department"] = m["department"].fillna("UNK")
    m["brand"] = m["brand"].fillna("UNK")

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)

    def agg(w, prefix):
        g = w.groupby("household_key")
        s = g.sales_value.sum().rename(prefix+"spend")
        t = g.basket_id.nunique().rename(prefix+"trips")
        q = g.quantity.sum().rename(prefix+"qty")

```python
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

def fn(view, d):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name="household_key")
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)

    # --- trailing windows ---
    for w in (28, 56, 84, 112, 182, 364):
        wtx = tx[tx.day > d - w]
        g = wtx.groupby("household_key")
        out[f"spend_{w}d"] = g["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        out[f"trips_{w}d"] = g["basket_id"].nunique().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        out[f"lines_{w}d"] = g.size().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    g_all = tx.groupby("household_key")
    out["days_since_last_trip"] = (d - g_all["day"].max()).reindex(hh)
    out["days_since_first_trip"] = (d - g_all["day"].min()).reindex(hh)
    out["trips_total"] = g_all["basket_id"].nunique().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    # avg basket value & interpurchase interval (last 112d)
    wtx = tx[tx.day > d - 112]
    bask = wtx.groupby(["household_key", "basket_id"]).agg(spend=("sales_value","sum"), day=("day","first"))
    out["avg_basket_112d"] = bask.groupby("household_key")["spend"].mean().reindex(hh)
    td = bask.groupby("household_key")["day"].apply(lambda s: np.diff(np.sort(s.values)).mean() if len(s) > 1 else np.nan)
    out["mean_intertrip_112d"] = td.reindex(hh)

    # trend & stability
    out["trend_28_vs_prev28"] = out["spend_28d"] / (out["spend_56d"] - out["spend_28d"] + 1.0)
    out["share_recent_28_of_112"] = out["spend_28d"] / (out["spend_112d"] + 1.0)
    out["log_spend_28d"] = np.log1p(out["spend_28d"])
    out["log_spend_364d"] = np.log1p(out["spend_364d"])
    out["spend_per_trip_84d"] = out["spend_84d"] / (out["trips_84d"] + 1.0)

    # promo sensitivity
    for w in (84, 364):
        wtx = tx[tx.day > d - w]
        g = wtx.groupby("household_key")
        disc = (g["coupon_disc"].sum() + g["coupon_match_disc"].sum() + g["retail_disc"].sum()).abs()
        out[f"promo_disc_{w}d"] = disc.reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        out[f"promo_share_{w}d"] = (disc / (out[f"spend_{w}d"] + 1.0))

    # quantity / unit price
    wtx = tx[tx.day > d - 84]
    g = wtx.groupby("household_key")
    out["units_84d"] = g["quantity"].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
    out["unit_price_84d"] = out["spend_84d"] / (out["units_84d"].replace(0, np.nan))
    out["lines_per_trip_84d"] = out["lines_84d"] / (out["trips_84d"] + 1.0)

    # --- product mix ---
    prod = view.table("products").drop_duplicates("product_id")[["product_id", "department", "brand"]]
    txp = tx.merge(prod, on="product_id", how="left")
    wtx = txp[txp.day > d - 364]
    piv = wtx.pivot_table(index="household_key", columns="department", values="sales_value", aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0.0)
    top = piv.sum().nlargest(10).index
    tot = piv.sum(axis=1)
    for dep in top:
        out[f"depshare_{dep}"] = piv[dep] / (tot + 1e-9)
    nb = wtx[wtx.brand == "National"].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum()
    out["national_brand_share_364d"] = (nb / (tot + 1e-9)).reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)  # careful: tot is per dept piv sum

```python
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

def fn(view, d):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name="household_key")
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)

    # --- trailing windows ---
    for w in (28, 56, 84, 112, 182, 364):
        wtx = tx[tx.day > d - w]
        g = wtx.groupby("household_key")
        out[f"spend_{w}d"] = g["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        out[f"trips_{w}d"] = g["basket_id"].nunique().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        out[f"lines_{w}d"] = g.size().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    g_all = tx.groupby("household_key")
    out["days_since_last_trip"] = (d - g_all["day"].max()).reindex(hh)
    out["days_since_first_trip"] = (d - g_all["day"].min()).reindex(hh)
    out["trips_total"] = g_all["basket_id"].nunique().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    # avg basket value & interpurchase interval (last 112d)
    wtx = tx[tx.day > d - 112]
    bask = wtx.groupby(["household_key", "basket_id"]).agg(spend=("sales_value","sum"), day=("day","first"))
    out["avg_basket_112d"] = bask.groupby("household_key")["spend"].mean().reindex(hh)
    td = bask.groupby("household_key")["day"].apply(lambda s: np.diff(np.sort(s.values)).mean() if len(s) > 1 else np.nan)
    out["mean_intertrip_112d"] = td.reindex(hh)

    # trend & stability
    out["trend_28_vs_prev28"] = out["spend_28d"] / (out["spend_56d"] - out["spend_28d"] + 1.0)
    out["share_recent_28_of_112"] = out["spend_28d"] / (out["spend_112d"] + 1.0)
    out["log_spend_28d"] = np.log1p(out["spend_28d"])
    out["log_spend_364d"] = np.log1p(out["spend_364d"])
    out["spend_per_trip_84d"] = out["spend_84d"] / (out["trips_84d"] + 1.0)

    # promo sensitivity
    for w in (84, 364):
        wtx = tx[tx.day > d - w]
        g = wtx.groupby("household_key")
        disc = (g["coupon_disc"].sum() + g["coupon_match_disc"].sum() + g["retail_disc"].sum()).abs()
        out[f"promo_disc_{w}d"] = disc.reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        out[f"promo_share_{w}d"] = (disc / (out[f"spend_{w}d"] + 1.0))

    # quantity / unit price
    wtx = tx[tx.day > d - 84]
    g = wtx.groupby("household_key")
    out["units_84d"] = g["quantity"].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
    out["unit_price_84d"] = out["spend_84d"] / (out["units_84d"].replace(0, np.nan))
    out["lines_per_trip_84d"] = out["lines_84d"] / (out["trips_84d"] + 1.0)

    # --- product mix ---
    prod = view.table("products").drop_duplicates("product_id")[["product_id", "department", "brand"]]
    txp = tx.merge(prod, on="product_id", how="left")
    wtx = txp[txp.day > d - 364]
    piv = wtx.pivot_table(index="household_key", columns="department", values="sales_value", aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0.0)
    top = piv.sum().nlargest(10).index
    tot = piv.sum(axis=1)
    for dep in top:
        out[f"depshare_{dep}"] = piv[dep] / (tot + 1e-9)
    nb = wtx[wtx.brand == "National"].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum()
    out["national_brand_share_364d"] = (nb / (tot + 1e-9)).reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)  # careful: tot is per dept piv sum
```

        P = P.reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        return P.values

    W = weekmat(list(range(w0-12, w0)))
    out["active_weeks_12"] = (W > 0).sum(1) / 12.0
    out["weekly_mean_12"] = W.mean(1)
    out["weekly_std_12"] = W.std(1)
    out["weekly_max_12"] = W.max(1)
    x = np.arange(12, dtype=float); xm = x - x.mean(); sx = (xm*wm).sum()
    Wc = W - W.mean(1, keepdims=True)

    W26 = weekmat(list(range(w0-26, w0)))
    Z = W26 <= 0
    streak = np.zeros(len(hh)); act = np.ones(len(hh), bool)
    for j in range(25, -1, -1):
        add = Z[:, j] & act
        streak += add
        act &= Z[:, j]
    out["zero_streak_wk"] = streak

    out["spend_cur_wk"] = wsum(7*w0 - 9, d0).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)

    first = pd.Series(day, index=hk).groupby(level=0).min().reindex(hh)
    tot = pd.Series(sv, index=hk).groupby(level=0).sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out["total_spend"] = tot
    out["days_since_first"] = (d0 - first).astype(float)
    span = (d0 - first + 1).clip(lower=1).astype(float)
    out["avg_weekly_all"] = tot * 7.0 / span
    nwk = pd.Series(wkarr, index=hk).groupby(level=0).nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0).astype(float)

    out["trips_84"] = trips

Current best: E005 with MAE 61.050. Features include demographics, calendar, transaction history (trailing windows), product mix, marketing (campaigns, coupons), recency-weighted spend, weekly spend level/variability, same-window-last-year.

The target is future 4-week spend. MAE ~61 on a target that is probably right-skewed (many households with low spend, some heavy spenders). 

Ideas for improvement:
1. **Lagged target values**: the best predictor of future 4-week spend is probably the same household's spend in the previous 4-week windows — specifically spend in (snapshot_day-28, snapshot_day], (snapshot_day-56, snapshot_day-28], etc. E001 had spend in 28-day window which is close, but maybe more granular: spend in each of the last 3-4 four-week blocks, and ratios like recent4/prev4. E005 added window ratios and same-window-last-year. Hmm.

2. **Zero-inflation / heavy tail**: MAE is minimized by conditional median. The model is fixed (unknown regression model — probably gradient boosting or ridge?). We can't change the model. But we can transform features. If the model is linear, log-transforming spend features could help a lot. If it's GBM, monotone transforms don't matter much. We don't know the model. Given E000 (demographics only) got 92.5 and E001 got 61.5, the model might be something like HistGradientBoosting or Ridge. Hard to say.

3. **Interaction features**: household-level behavior × demographics.

4. **Better recency structure**: spend in the exact last 28 days is the strongest single predictor typically. Also "future_spend_4w" for a household = spend in next 28 days. Autocorrelation of 4-week blocks: lag1 (days snapshot-27..snapshot), lag2, lag3, lag4. Also same household's spend at the same phase in previous 28-day cycles (i.e., lag 13 blocks = 364 days — E005 had same-window-last-year).

5. **Per-household mean spend level** (long-run average weekly spend) — probably already covered by 364-day window.

6. **Trend features**: slope of spend over recent weeks (E005 added trend).

        bsg = bs.groupby(level=0)
        out[f'n_trips_{w}'] = ntrips.reindex(hh).fillna(0)
        out[f'bk_mean_{w}'] = bsg.mean().reindex(hh)

        out[f'bk_std_{w}'] = bsg.std().reindex(hh)
        out[f'items_per_trip_{w}'] = (g['quantity'].sum() / ntrips).reindex(hh)

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    d = snapshot_day
    hh = view.households
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    tx = tx[tx.day <= d]
    # windows
    for w in (28, 84):
        tw = tx[tx.day > d - w]
        g = tw.groupby("household_key")
        f[f"n_stores_{w}"] = g["store_id"].nunique()
        ss = tw.groupby(["household_key","store_id"])["sales_value"].sum()
        tot = ss.groupby(level=0).sum()
        f[f"top_store_share_{w}"] = ss.groupby(level=0).max() / tot.replace(0, np.nan)
        bs = tw.groupby(["household_key","basket_id"])["sales_value"].sum()
        gb = bs.groupby(level=0)
        f[f"basket_mean_{w}"] = gb.mean()
        f[f"basket_max_{w}"] = gb.max()
        ln = tw.groupby(["household_key","basket_id"]).size()
        f[f"lines_per_basket_{w}"] = ln.groupby(level=0).mean()
        f[f"n_products_{w}"] = g["product_id"].nunique()
    tw84 = tx[tx.day > d - 84]
    g84 = tw84.groupby("household_key")
    sv = g84["sales_value"].sum().abs() + 1e-9
    f["retail_disc_share_84"] = g84["retail_disc"].sum().abs() / sv
    f["coupon_disc_share_84"] = (g84["coupon_disc"].sum().abs() + g84["coupon_match_disc"].sum().abs()) / sv
    f["mean_trans_time_84"] = g84["trans_time"].mean()
    f["evening_share_84"] = tw84.assign(ev=tw84["trans_time"] >= 1700).groupby("household_key")["ev"].mean()

        bs = tw.groupby(["household_key","basket_id"])["sales_value"].sum()
        gb = bs.groupby(level=0)
        add(gb.mean(), f"e7_basket_mean_{w}")
        add(gb.max(), f"e7_basket_max_{w}")
        ln = tw.groupby(["household_key","basket_id"]).size()
        add(ln.groupby(level=0).mean(), f"e7_lines_per_basket_{w}")

    tw28 = tx[tx["day"] > d - 28]

    g84 = tw84.groupby("household_key")
    sv = g84["sales_value"].sum().abs() + 1e-9

    add((g84["coupon_disc"].sum().abs() + g84["coupon_match_disc"].sum().abs()) / sv, "e7_coupon_disc_share_84")

    add(d - tx.groupby("household_key")["day"].min(), "e7_tenure_days")
    add(tw84.assign(we=tw84["day"] % 7 >= 5).groupby("household_key")["we"].mean(), "e7_weekend_share_84")
    add(tw84.groupby("household_key")["day"].apply(lambda s: s % 7).groupby(level=0).mean(), "e7_dow_mean_84")

import numpy as np, pandas as pd

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = view.households
    if isinstance(hh, pd.DataFrame): hh = hh.index if 'household_key' not in hh.columns else hh['household_key']
    hh = pd.Index(hh)
    tx = view.table("transactions")[["household_key","basket_id","day","sales_value","product_id","quantity"]]
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    d = tx["day"]
    g = tx.groupby("household_key")
    first_day = g["day"].min()
    total_spend = g["sales_value"].sum()
    n_trips = g["basket_id"].nunique()
    tenure = (snapshot_day - first_day).clip(lower=28)
    out["tenure_days"] = tenure.reindex(hh)
    out["lr28_all"] = (total_spend * 28.0 / tenure).reindex(hh)
    out["triprate_all"] = (n_trips * 28.0 / tenure).reindex(hh)

    def wsum(lo):  # days > lo
        return tx.loc[d > lo].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum()
    def wtrips(lo):
        return tx.loc[d > lo].groupby("household_key")["basket_id"].nunique()

    spend364 = wsum(snapshot_day-364)
    out["lr28_364"] = (spend364/13.0).reindex(hh)
    out["triprate_364"] = (wtrips(snapshot_day-364)/13.0).reindex(hh)

    for w in [7,14,21,28]:
        out[f"spend_{w}d"] = wsum(snapshot_day-w).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    for w in [7,14,28]:
        out[f"trips_{w}d"] = wtrips(snapshot_day-w).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)

    s28 = out["spend_28d"]
    out["ratio28_lr364"] = s28 / out["lr28_364"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    out["ratio28_lrall"] = s28 / out["lr28_all"].replace(0.0, np.nan)

    last_day = g["day"].max()
    dsl = (snapshot_day - last_day).reindex(hh)
    out["dsl"] = dsl
    exp_gap = 28.0 / out["triprate_364"].clip(lower=0.25)
    out["dorm_ratio"] = dsl / exp_gap

    # 28d block stats trailing 364d
    blocks = np.stack([...])  # 13 blocks
    B = []
    for k in range(1,14):
        hi = snapshot_day - 28*(k-1)
        lo = hi - 28
        B.append(tx.loc[(d > lo) & (d <= hi)].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0).values)
    B = np.vstack(B)  # 13 x H
    out["blk_mean"] = B.mean(0)
    out["blk_med"] = np.median(B, 0)
    out["blk_std"] = B.std(0)
    out["blk_max"] = B.max(0)
    out["blk_zero_share"] = (B == 0).mean(0)
    out["blk_cv"] = out["blk_std"] / out["blk_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # department spend last 28d, top departments by 364d spend
    prod = view.table("products")[["product_id","department"]]
    t28 = tx.loc[d > snapshot_day-28]
    m28 = t28.merge(prod, on="product_id", how="left")
    top = tx.loc[d > snapshot_day-364].merge(prod, on="product_id", how="left").groupby("department")["sales_value"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
    top = [x for x in top.index[:10] if isinstance(x, str)][:10]
    piv = m28.groupby(["household_key","department"])["sales_value"].sum().unstack()
    piv = piv.reindex(columns=top)
    piv.index.name = None
    piv = piv.reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    piv.columns = ["dept28_" + re.sub(r"\W+","_",str(c))[:20] for c in piv.columns]
    for c in piv.columns: out[c] = piv[c]

    # avg basket value, units
    q28 = t28.groupby("household_key")["quantity"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out["units_28d"] = q28
    out["avg_basket_28d"] = s28 / out["trips_28d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    return out
```

def fn(view, snapshot_day):

    if isinstance(hh, pd.DataFrame):

    def feats_at(t):

        ten = np.maximum(t - fd, 28)

        idx = np.arange(1, D+1)
        lt = np.where(T[:, :t] > 0, idx[:t][None,:], 0).cummax(1)[:, -1]
        dsl = np.where(lt > 0, t - lt, t).clip(0, 112)
        trips364 = T[:, max(t-363,1)-1:t].sum(1)

        X = np.column_stack([
            np.log1p(spend28), np.log1p(spend28p), np.log1p(spend56),
            np.log1p(lr28), trips28, dsl, dorm, actshare,
            np.minimum(t-fd, 730.0), spend28/(spend56+1.0)

        mu = X.mean(0); sd = X.std(0); sd[sd==0]=1.0
        Z = (X-mu)/sd
        A = Z.T@Z + alpha*np.eye(Z.shape[1])
        w = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@y)
        return mu, sd, w

    def ridge_pred(model, X):
        mu, sd, w = model
        return ((X-mu)/sd)@w

    out["m_pred_act"] = pa
    out["m_resid"] = s28 - pr
    out["m_ratio"] = s28/(pr+1.0)
    out["m_prod"] = pr*pa
    return out

import numpy as np, pandas as pd

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = view.households
    if isinstance(hh, pd.DataFrame): hh = hh.index if 'household_key' not in hh.columns else hh['household_key']
    hh = pd.Index(hh)
    tx = view.table("transactions")[["household_key","basket_id","day","sales_value","product_id","quantity"]]
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    d = tx["day"]
    g = tx.groupby("household_key")
    first_day = g["day"].min()
    total_spend = g["sales_value"].sum()
    n_trips = g["basket_id"].nunique()
    tenure = (snapshot_day - first_day).clip(lower=28)
    out["tenure_days"] = tenure.reindex(hh)
    out["lr28_all"] = (total_spend * 28.0 / tenure).reindex(hh)
    out["triprate_all"] = (n_trips * 28.0 / tenure).reindex(hh)

    def wsum(lo):  # days > lo
        return tx.loc[d > lo].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum()
    def wtrips(lo):
        return tx.loc[d > lo].groupby("household_key")["basket_id"].nunique()

    spend364 = wsum(snapshot_day-364)
    out["lr28_364"] = (spend364/13.0).reindex(hh)
    out["triprate_364"] = (wtrips(snapshot_day-364)/13.0).reindex(hh)

    for w in [7,14,21,28]:
        out[f"spend_{w}d"] = wsum(snapshot_day-w).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    for w in [7,14,28]:
        out[f"trips_{w}d"] = wtrips(snapshot_day-w).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)

    s28 = out["spend_28d"]
    out["ratio28_lr364"] = s28 / out["lr28_364"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    out["ratio28_lrall"] = s28 / out["lr28_all"].replace(0.0, np.nan)

    last_day = g["day"].max()
    dsl = (snapshot_day - last_day).reindex(hh)
    out["dsl"] = dsl
    exp_gap = 28.0 / out["triprate_364"].clip(lower=0.25)
    out["dorm_ratio"] = dsl / exp_gap

    # 28d block stats trailing 364d
    blocks = np.stack([...])  # 13 blocks
    B = []
    for k in range(1,14):
        hi = snapshot_day - 28*(k-1)
        lo = hi - 28
        B.append(tx.loc[(d > lo) & (d <= hi)].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0).values)
    B = np.vstack(B)  # 13 x H
    out["blk_mean"] = B.mean(0)
    out["blk_med"] = np.median(B, 0)
    out["blk_std"] = B.std(0)
    out["blk_max"] = B.max(0)
    out["blk_zero_share"] = (B == 0).mean(0)
    out["blk_cv"] = out["blk_std"] / out["blk_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # department spend last 28d, top departments by 364d spend
    prod = view.table("products")[["product_id","department"]]
    t28 = tx.loc[d > snapshot_day-28]
    m28 = t28.merge(prod, on="product_id", how="left")
    top = tx.loc[d > snapshot_day-364].merge(prod, on="product_id", how="left").groupby("department")["sales_value"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
    top = [x for x in top.index[:10] if isinstance(x, str)][:10]
    piv = m28.groupby(["household_key","department"])["sales_value"].sum().unstack()
    piv = piv.reindex(columns=top)
    piv.index.name = None
    piv = piv.reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    piv.columns = ["dept28_" + re.sub(r"\W+","_",str(c))[:20] for c in piv.columns]
    for c in piv.columns: out[c] = piv[c]

    # avg basket value, units
    q28 = t28.groupby("household_key")["quantity"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out["units_28d"] = q28
    out["avg_basket_28d"] = s28 / out["trips_28d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    return out

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, re

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = view.households
    if isinstance(hh, pd.DataFrame):
        hh = hh["household_key"] if "household_key" in hh.columns else hh.index
    hh = pd.Index(hh)
    tx = view.table("transactions")[["household_key","basket_id","day","sales_value","product_id","quantity"]]
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    d = tx["day"]
    g = tx.groupby("household_key")
    first_day = g["day"].min()
    total_spend = g["sales_value"].sum()
    n_trips = g["basket_id"].nunique()
    tenure = (snapshot_day - first_day).clip(lower=28)
    out["tenure_days"] = tenure.reindex(hh)
    out["lr28_all"] = (total_spend * 28.0 / tenure).reindex(hh)
    out["triprate_all"] = (n_trips * 28.0 / tenure).reindex(hh)

    def wsum(lo, col="sales_value"):
        return tx.loc[d > lo].groupby("household_key")[col].sum()
    def wtrips(lo):
        return tx.loc[d > lo].groupby("household_key")["basket_id"].nunique()

    out["lr28_364"] = (wsum(snapshot_day-364)/13.0).reindex(hh)
    out["triprate_364"] = (wtrips(snapshot_day-364)/13.0).reindex(hh)

    for w in [7,14,21,28]:
        out["spend_%dd" % w] = wsum(snapshot_day-w).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    for w in [7,14,28]:
        out["trips_%dd" % w] = wtrips(snapshot_day-w).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)

    s28 = out["spend_28d"]
    out["ratio28_lr364"] = s28 / out["lr28_364"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    out["ratio28_lrall"] = s28 / out["lr28_all"].replace(0.0, np.nan)

    dsl = (snapshot_day - g["day"].max()).reindex(hh)
    out["dsl"] = dsl
    out["dorm_ratio"] = dsl / (28.0 / out["triprate_364"].clip(lower=0.25))

    B = []
    for k in range(1,14):
        hi = snapshot_day - 28*(k-1); lo = hi - 28
        B.append(tx.loc[(d > lo) & (d <= hi)].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0).values)
    B = np.vstack(B)
    out["blk_mean"] = B.mean(0); out["blk_med"] = np.median(B,0); out["blk_std"] = B.std(0)
    out["blk_max"] = B.max(0); out["blk_zero_share"] = (B==0).mean(0)
    out["blk_cv"] = out["blk_std"] / out["blk_mean"].replace(0.0, np.nan)

    prod = view.table("products")[["product_id","department"]]
    t28 = tx.loc[d > snapshot_day-28]
    top = (tx.loc[d > snapshot_day-364].merge(prod, on="product_id", how="left")
             .groupby("department")["sales_value"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).index[:10])
    piv = (t28.merge(prod, on="product_id", how="left")
              .groupby(["household_key","department"])["sales_value"].sum().unstack()
              .reindex(columns=[c for c in top]).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0))
    piv.columns = ["dept28_" + re.sub(r"\W+","_",str(c))[:24] for c in piv.columns]
    for c in piv.columns: out[c] = piv[c].values

    t28g = t28.groupby("household_key")
    out["units_28d"] = t28g["quantity"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out["avg_basket_28d"] = s28 / out["trips_28d"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    if snapshot_day in (95, 123):
        print("E008 snap", snapshot_day, out.shape, "nulls:", int(out.isna().sum().sum()))
    return out

df = agent_api.build_features(fn)

path = agent_api.save_table(df, "e008_level_dormancy")

```python
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, re

# ---------- E008 feature block (same as before) ----------
def base_features(view, snapshot_day, hh):
    ... returns DataFrame out ...

# ---------- stacked ridge ----------
def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = ...
    tx = view.table("transactions")[["household_key","basket_id","day","sales_value"]]
    out = base_features(view, snapshot_day, hh)

    # daily matrices over all households in tx
    hh_all = pd.Index(tx["household_key"].unique())
    D = snapshot_day
    sp = tx.groupby(["household_key","day"])["sales_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    tr = tx.groupby(["household_key","day"])["basket_id"].nunique().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    cols = np.arange(1, D+1)
    sp = sp.reindex(index=hh_all, columns=cols, fill_value=0.0)
    tr = tr.reindex(index=hh_all, columns=cols, fill_value=0.0)
    S = sp.values; T = tr.values
    fd = tx.groupby("household_key")["day"].min().reindex(hh_all).values  # first day

    def feats_at(t):
        t = int(t)
        a = max(t-27,1); b = t
        spend28 = S[:, a-1:b].sum(1)
        spend28p = S[:, max(t-55,1)-1:max(t-27,1)].sum(1)   # days t-55..t-28
        spend56 = S[:, max(t-55,1)-1:t].sum(1)
        cum = S[:, :t].cumsum(1)
        tot = cum[:, -1]
        ten = np.maximum(t - fd, 28)
        lr28 = tot*28.0/ten
        trips28 = T[:, a-1:b].sum(1)
        idx = np.arange(1, D+1)
        lt = np.where(T[:, :t] > 0, idx[:t][None,:], 0).cummax(1)[:, -1]
        dsl = np.where(lt > 0, t - lt, t).clip(0, 112)
        trips364 = T[:, max(t-363,1)-1:t].sum(1)
        exgap = 364.0/np.maximum(trips364,1.0)
        dorm = np.clip(dsl/exgap, 0, 10)
        # active blocks trailing 364
        act = np.zeros(len(hh_all))
        for k in range(1,14):
            hi = t-28*(k-1); lo = hi-28
            if lo < 0: break
            blk = S[:, max(lo,0):hi].sum(1)
            act += (blk > 0)
        actshare = act/13.0
        X = np.column_stack([
            np.log1p(spend28), np.log1p(spend28p), np.log1p(spend56),
            np.log1p(lr28), trips28, dsl, dorm, actshare,
            np.minimum(t-fd, 730.0), spend28/(spend56+1.0)
        ])
        return X

    def ridge_fit(X, y, alpha):
        mu = X.mean(0); sd = X.std(0); sd[sd==0]=1.0
        Z = (X-mu)/sd
        A = Z.T@Z + alpha*np.eye(Z.shape[1])
        w = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@y)
        return mu, sd, w

    def ridge_pred(model, X):
        mu, sd, w = model
        return ((X-mu)/sd)@w

    K = 8
    Xs, ys, ylogs, yact = [], [], [], []
    for k in range(1, K+1):
        t = snapshot_day - 28*k
        if t < 113: break
        Xk = feats_at(t)
        yk = S[:, t:t+28].sum(1)
        m = fd <= t-84
        Xs.append(Xk[m]); ys.append(yk[m]); ylogs.append(np.log1p(yk[m])); yact.append((yk[m]>0).astype(float))
    Xtr = np.vstack(Xs); ytr = np.concatenate(ys); ylog = np.concatenate(ylogs); yactv = np.concatenate(yact)

    # alpha selection on last two blocks
    # (blocks stored separately) — simpler: fixed alphas
    m_raw = ridge_fit(Xtr, ytr, 30.0)
    m_log = ridge_fit(Xtr, ylog, 30.0)
    m_act = ridge_fit(Xtr, yactv, 30.0)

    X0 = feats_at(snapshot_day)
    elig = fd <= snapshot_day-84
    pred_raw = np.full(len(hh_all), np.nan)
    pred_log = np.full(len(hh_all), np.nan)
    pred_act = np.full(len(hh_all), np.nan)
    pred_raw[elig] = np.clip(ridge_pred(m_raw, X0[elig]), 0, None)
    pred_log[elig] = np.clip(np.expm1(ridge_pred(m_log, X0[elig])), 0, None)
    pred_act[elig] = np.clip(ridge_pred(m_act, X0[elig]), 0, 1)

    pos = hh_all.get_indexer(hh)
    pr = pred_raw[pos]; pl = pred_log[pos]; pa = pred_act[pos]
    s28 = out["spend_28d"].values
    out["m_pred_raw"] = pr
    out["m_pred_log"] = pl
    out["m_pred_act"] = pa
    out["m_resid"] = s28 - pr
    out["m_ratio"] = s28/(pr+1.0)
    out["m_prod"] = pr*pa
    return out
```

```python
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import agent_api as A

BASE = 'e006_zero_inflation.parquet'

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    s = snapshot_day
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name='household_key')  # view.households maybe list/Series
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    prod = view.table('products')
    dm = view.table('display_mailer')

    base = A.load_saved(BASE)
    base = base[base['snapshot_day'] == s]
    base = base.set_index('household_key') if 'household_key' in base.columns else base

    out = {}
    # windows
    for w, name in [(7,'7'),(14,'14'),(28,'28'),(84,'84')]:
        pass
    tx = tx.copy()
    # spend/trip windows
    def win(d):
        return tx[tx['day'] > s - d]
    for d in (7,14):
        t = win(d)
        g = t.groupby('household_key')['sales_value']
        out[f'spend_{d}d'] = g.sum()
        out[f'trips_{d}d'] = t.groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    # trip stats 84d
    t84 = win(84)
    trip = t84.groupby(['household_key','basket_id'])['sales_value'].sum().reset_index()
    tg = trip.groupby('household_key')['sales_value']
    out['trip_spend_mean_84'] = tg.mean()
    out['trip_spend_max_84'] = tg.max()
    out['trip_spend_std_84'] = tg.std()
    # discount shares
    disc_cols = ['coupon_disc','coupon_match_disc','retail_disc']
    agg = t84.groupby('household_key').agg(sp=('sales_value','sum'), cd=('coupon_disc','sum'), cmd=('coupon_match_disc','sum'), rd=('retail_disc','sum'))
    tot_disc = -(agg['cd'] + agg['cmd'] + agg['rd'])
    out['disc_share_84'] = tot_disc / (agg['sp'].abs() + 1e-6)
    a364 = tx[tx['day'] > s-364].groupby('household_key').agg(sp=('sales_value','sum'), cd=('coupon_disc','sum'), cmd=('coupon_match_disc','sum'), rd=('retail_disc','sum'))
    out['disc_share_364'] = -(a364['cd']+a364['cmd']+a364['rd']) / (a364['sp'].abs()+1e-6)
    # store
    sg = t84.groupby('household_key')['store_id']
    out['n_stores_84'] = sg.nunique()
    st = t84.groupby(['household_key','store_id'])['sales_value'].sum()
    out['top_store_share_84'] = st.groupby(level=0).max() / (t84.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum() + 1e-6)
    # dow concentration + time
    t84b = t84.assign(dow=t84['day'] % 7)
    dw = t84b.groupby(['household_key','dow'])['sales_value'].sum()
    out['dow_top_share_84'] = dw.groupby(level=0).max() / (t84.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()+1e-6)
    tt = t84.assign(tm=(t84['trans_time']//100)*60 + (t84['trans_time']%100))
    out['mean_trans_time_84'] = tt.groupby('household_key')['tm'].mean()
    # display/mailer exposure 84d
    if len(dm) > 0:
        m = t84.merge(dm[['product_id','store_id','week_no','display','mailer']], on=['product_id','store_id','week_no'], how='left')
        m['has_disp'] = m['display'].notna() & (m['display'].astype(str) != '0')
        m['has_mail'] = m['mailer'].notna() & (m['mailer'].astype(str) != '0')
        sp = m.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        out['disp_spend_share_84'] = m[m['has_disp']].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum() / (sp+1e-6)
        out['mail_spend_share_84'] = m[m['has_mail']].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum() / (sp+1e-6)
        out['n_disp_products_84'] = m[m['has_disp']].groupby('household_key')['product_id'].nunique()
    # dept 28d spend for top-5 depts (by 84d total spend)
    t28 = win(28)
    pmap = prod.set_index('product_id')['department']
    d84 = t84.assign(dept=t84['product_id'].map(pmap)).groupby('dept')['sales_value'].sum()
    top5 = d84.nlargest(5).index
    d28 = t28.assign(dept=t28['product_id'].map(pmap))
    d28 = d28[d28['dept'].isin(top5)]
    piv = d28.pivot_table(index='household_key', columns='dept', values='sales_value', aggfunc='sum')
    piv.columns = [f'spend28_{str(c)[:12]}' for c in piv.columns]
    for c in piv.columns: out[c] = piv[c]

    out['mean_trans_time_84'] = tt.groupby('household_key')['tm'].mean()
    # display/mailer exposure 84d

        m['has_disp'] = m['display'].notna() & (m['display'].astype(str) != '0')
        m['has_mail'] = m['mailer'].notna() & (m['mailer'].astype(str) != '0')
        sp = m.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()

        out['mail_spend_share_84'] = m[m['has_mail']].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum() / (sp+1e-6)
        out['n_disp_products_84'] = m[m['has_disp']].groupby('household_key')['product_id'].nunique()

import agent_api as A
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

e6 = A.load_saved('e006_zero_inflation.parquet')

def entropy(p):
    p = p[p>0]
    if len(p)==0: return 0.0
    p = p/p.sum()
    return float(-(p*np.log(p)).sum())

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    hh = view.households  # households needing a row
    day = view.day
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    t = tx[tx.day > day-84]
    t28 = tx[tx.day > day-28]
    t364 = tx[tx.day > day-364]
    # store features
    st = t.groupby('household_key').store_id
    out['s_nstores_84'] = st.nunique()
    out['s_nstores_28'] = t28.groupby('household_key').store_id.nunique()
    out['s_nstores_364'] = t364.groupby('household_key').store_id.nunique()
    # store entropy of spend
    se = t.groupby(['household_key','store_id']).sales_value.sum().reset_index()
    out['s_store_ent_84'] = se.groupby('household_key').sales_value.apply(entropy)
    # top store spend share 84 (E006 has top_store_share_84 — maybe trips-based; add spend-based shift)
    top = se.groupby('household_key').sales_value.max()
    tot = se.groupby('household_key').sales_value.sum()
    out['s_topstore_spend_share_84'] = top/tot
    # loyalty shift: top store share 28 vs 84
    se28 = t28.groupby(['household_key','store_id']).sales_value.sum().reset_index()
    top28 = se28.groupby('household_key').sales_value.max(); tot28 = se28.groupby('household_key').sales_value.sum()
    out['s_topstore_share_28'] = top28/tot28
    out['s_loyalty_shift'] = (top28/tot28).sub(top/tot)  # careful alignment
    ...

    s = s[s > 0]
    if len(s) == 0:

    # ---- store behaviour ----

    out['s_nstores_28'] = t28.groupby('household_key').store_id.nunique()
    out['s_nstores_364'] = tx[tx.day > day-364].groupby('household_key').store_id.nunique()

    se = t84.groupby(['household_key','store_id']).sales_value.sum()
    out['s_store_ent_84'] = se.groupby(level=0).apply(entropy)
    top84 = se.groupby(level=0).max(); tot84 = se.groupby(level=0).sum()
    out['s_topstore_spend_share_84'] = top84 / tot84

    se28 = t28.groupby(['household_key','store_id']).sales_value.sum()
    top28 = se28.groupby(level=0).max(); tot28 = se28.groupby(level=0).sum()

    cspend = m84.groupby(['household_key','commodity_desc']).sales_value.sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, agent_api, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

def build_eb(view, snapshot_day):
    s = int(snapshot_day)
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    tx = tx[tx.day <= s]
    d = tx["day"].to_numpy()
    j = ((s - d) // 28) + 1
    df = pd.DataFrame({"h": tx["household_key"].to_numpy(), "j": j, "v": tx["sales_value"].to_numpy()})
    bs = df.groupby(["h","j"], as_index=False)["v"].sum().rename(columns={"v":"B"})
    # global priors
    gm = float(bs["B"].mean()) if len(bs) else 0.0
    ga = float((bs["B"] > 0).mean()) if len(bs) else 0.0
    pos = bs.loc[bs["B"] > 0, "B"]
    gma = float(pos.mean()) if len(pos) else 0.0
    rows = {}
    for h, sub in bs.groupby("h", sort=False):
        sub = sub.sort_values("j")
        B = sub["B"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        K = len(B)
        nact = int((B > 0).sum())
        meanB = B.mean(); sumB = B.sum()
        stdB = B.std(ddof=1) if K > 1 else 0.0
        medB = float(np.median(B)); maxB = B.max(); minB = B.min()
        act = nact / K
        mact = B[B > 0].mean() if nact > 0 else 0.0
        sact = B[B > 0].sum()
        tt = np.arange(K, dtype=float)
        slope = float(np.polyfit(tt, B, 1)[0]) if K > 1 and stdB > 0 else 0.0
        w = np.power(0.5, tt / 2.0)
        dec = float((w * B).sum() / w.sum())
        if K > 1:
            prev = B[1:] > 0; cur = B[:-1] > 0
            p11 = float(cur[prev].mean()) if prev.any() else np.nan
            p01 = float(cur[~prev].mean()) if (~prev).any() else np.nan
        else:
            p11 = p01 = np.nan
        if nact > 0:
            shr_mact = (sact + 3.0 * gma) / (nact + 3.0)
        else:
            shr_mact = gma
        shr_mean = (sumB + 3.0 * gm) / (K + 3.0)
        shr_act = (nact + 3.0 * ga) / (K + 3.0)
        exp_eb = shr_act * shr_mact
        # gap
        hd = df.loc[df.h == h]  # too slow; better compute last day via groupby
        ...

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, agent_api, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
tt = agent_api.train_targets()
fe = agent_api.load_saved("e006_zero_inflation.parquet")
df = fe.merge(tt, on=["household_key","snapshot_day"], how="inner")
ycol = "future_spend_4w"
cat = [c for c in df.columns if df[c].dtype.name in ("object","category","bool")]
num = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ("household_key","snapshot_day",ycol) and c not in cat]
X = pd.concat([df[num], pd.get_dummies(df[cat].astype(str), dummy_na=True)], axis=1).astype(float)
X = X.replace([np.inf,-np.inf], np.nan).fillna(X.median())
X = X.loc[:, X.std()>0]
y = df[ycol].values
tr = (df.snapshot_day<=403).values; va = (df.snapshot_day==431).values
Xtr = X.values[tr]; ytr = y[tr]; Xva = X.values[va]; yva = y[va]
mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0); sd[sd==0]=1
Ztr = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Ztr = np.c_[np.ones(len(Ztr)), Ztr]
lam = 300
A = Ztr.T@Ztr + lam*np.eye(Ztr.shape[1]); A[0,0] -= lam
w = np.linalg.solve(A, Ztr.T@ytr)
def mae(Zva):
    Z = np.c_[np.ones(len(Zva)), Zva]
    return np.abs(np.clip(Z@w,0,None) - yva).mean()
base = mae((Xva-mu)/sd)
print("base MAE(431):", round(base,2))
# blocks

for c in X.columns:

    elif c.startswith("z_"): b="zeroint"

def run(feat_list, train_days, hold_days, lam):
    tr = m['snapshot_day'].isin(train_days).values
    va = m['snapshot_day'].isin(hold_days).values
    Xtr = Xdf.loc[tr, feat_list].values.astype(float)
    Xva = Xdf.loc[va, feat_list].values.astype(float)
    med = np.nanmedian(Xtr, axis=0)
    med = np.where(np.isnan(med), 0.0, med)
    Xtr = np.where(np.isnan(Xtr), med, Xtr)
    Xva = np.where(np.isnan(Xva), med, Xva)
    mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0); sd[sd==0]=1
    Xtr = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Xva = (Xva-mu)/sd
    ytr = y_all[tr]; yva = y_all[va]
    Xb = np.hstack([Xtr, np.ones((len(Xtr),1))])
    p = Xb.shape[1]
    pen = np.eye(p)*lam; pen[-1,-1]=0
    w = np.linalg.solve(Xb.T@Xb + pen, Xb.T@ytr)
    pred = np.hstack([Xva, np.ones((len(Xva),1))]) @ w
    return float(np.abs(pred-yva).mean())

def ridge_fit(X, y, lam):
    n, p = X.shape

def run(feat_list, train_days, hold_days, lam):
    tr = m['snapshot_day'].isin(train_days).values
    va = m['snapshot_day'].isin(hold_days).values
    Xtr = Xdf.loc[tr, feat_list].values.astype(float)
    Xva = Xdf.loc[va, feat_list].values.astype(float)
    med = np.nanmedian(Xtr, axis=0)
    med = np.where(np.isnan(med), 0.0, med)
    Xtr = np.where(np.isnan(Xtr), med, Xtr)
    Xva = np.where(np.isnan(Xva), med, Xva)
    mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0); sd[sd==0]=1
    Xtr = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Xva = (Xva-mu)/sd
    ytr = y_all[tr]; yva = y_all[va]
    Xb = np.hstack([Xtr, np.ones((len(Xtr),1))])
    p = Xb.shape[1]
    pen = np.eye(p)*lam; pen[-1,-1]=0
    w = np.linalg.solve(Xb.T@Xb + pen, Xb.T@ytr)
    pred = np.hstack([Xva, np.ones((len(Xva),1))]) @ w
    return float(np.abs(pred-yva).mean())

print('--- lambda grid, all feats, H1 ---')

def boost(Xb_tr, ytr, Xb_all, rounds, lr, min_leaf):
    n, d = Xb_tr.shape
    F = np.full(n, ytr.mean()); Fall = np.full(Xb_all.shape[0], ytr.mean())
    stumps = []
    S = ytr.sum(); N = n
    for it in range(rounds):
        res = ytr - F
        best_gain = -np.inf; best = None
        for j in range(d):
            bj = Xb_tr[:, j]
            sw = np.bincount(bj, weights=res, minlength=40)
            cw = np.bincount(bj, minlength=40)
            csum = np.cumsum(sw); ccnt = np.cumsum(cw)
            # thresholds after bin t, t=0..K-2 where K=len(csum)
            ls = csum[:-1]; lc = ccnt[:-1]
            rs = csum[-1]-ls; rc = ccnt[-1]-lc
            ok = (lc>=min_leaf)&(rc>=min_leaf)
            if not ok.any(): continue
            score = np.where(ok, ls*ls/np.maximum(lc,1) + rs*rs/np.maximum(rc,1), -np.inf)
            k = int(np.argmax(score))
            if score[k] > best_gain:
                best_gain = score[k]; best = (j, k, ls[k]/max(lc[k],1), rs[k]/max(rc[k],1))
        if best is None: break
        j, k, vl, vr = best
        upd_tr = np.where(Xb_tr[:, j] <= k, vl, vr)
        upd_all = np.where(Xb_all[:, j] <= k, vl, vr)
        F += lr*upd_tr; Fall += lr*upd_all
        stumps.append((j,k,vl,vr))
    return Fall, stumps, F

def boost(Xb_tr, ytr, Xb_all, rounds, lr, min_leaf):
    n, d = Xb_tr.shape
    F = np.full(n, ytr.mean()); Fall = np.full(Xb_all.shape[0], ytr.mean())
    stumps = []
    S = ytr.sum(); N = n
    for it in range(rounds):
        res = ytr - F
        best_gain = -np.inf; best = None
        for j in range(d):
            bj = Xb_tr[:, j]
            sw = np.bincount(bj, weights=res, minlength=40)
            cw = np.bincount(bj, minlength=40)
            csum = np.cumsum(sw); ccnt = np.cumsum(cw)
            # thresholds after bin t, t=0..K-2 where K=len(csum)
            ls = csum[:-1]; lc = ccnt[:-1]
            rs = csum[-1]-ls; rc = ccnt[-1]-lc
            ok = (lc>=min_leaf)&(rc>=min_leaf)
            if not ok.any(): continue
            score = np.where(ok, ls*ls/np.maximum(lc,1) + rs*rs/np.maximum(rc,1), -np.inf)
            k = int(np.argmax(score))
            if score[k] > best_gain:
                best_gain = score[k]; best = (j, k, ls[k]/max(lc[k],1), rs[k]/max(rc[k],1))
        if best is None: break
        j, k, vl, vr = best
        upd_tr = np.where(Xb_tr[:, j] <= k, vl, vr)
        upd_all = np.where(Xb_all[:, j] <= k, vl, vr)
        F += lr*upd_tr; Fall += lr*upd_all
        stumps.append((j,k,vl,vr))
    return Fall, stumps, F
```

def fn(view, s):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    g = tx.groupby('household_key')
    first = g['day'].min()
    tenure = (s - first).clip(lower=0)
    # windows
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=first.index)
    out['tenure_cap364'] = tenure.clip(upper=364)
    for W in (112, 182, 364):
        w = tx[(tx.day > s - W)]
        sp = w.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        out[f'rate_{W}'] = sp.reindex(out.index).fillna(0) / tenure.clip(lower=1).clip(upper=W)  # per-day rate within available window
    tr = tx[tx.day > s-364].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    out['trips_rate_364'] = tr.reindex(out.index).fillna(0) / (tenure.clip(lower=1).clip(upper=364)/7)  # trips per week
    # decayed spend halflife 112 normalized
    age = s - tx['day']
    wgt = 0.5 ** (age / 112.0)
    dec = (tx['sales_value'] * wgt).groupby(tx['household_key']).sum()
    # normalization: divide by sum of weights over available window
    # sum of weights over days d in [first, s] = sum_{a=0}^{tenure-1} 0.5^(a/112) ≈ 112/ln2 * (1 - 0.5^(tenure/112))
    normw = (112.0/np.log(2)) * (1 - 0.5**(tenure/112.0))
    out['dec112_rate'] = dec.reindex(out.index).fillna(0) / normw.clip(lower=1e-9)
    return out

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def fn(view, s):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name='household_key')  # view.households — is it a list/array or DataFrame? "view.households: the households needing a row at that snapshot". Probably an Index/array.
    first = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh)
    tenure = (s - first).astype(float)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    out['tenure_cap364'] = tenure.clip(upper=364)
    eff = tenure.clip(lower=1).clip(upper=364)
    for W in (112, 182, 364):
        w = tx[tx.day > s - W]
        sp = w.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        out[f'rate_{W}'] = sp / eff.clip(upper=W) * 7  # weekly-equivalent rate
    tr = tx[tx.day > s - 364].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['trips_rate_364'] = tr / (eff / 7.0)
    age = (s - tx['day']).astype(float)
    dec = (tx['sales_value'] * (0.5 ** (age / 112.0))).groupby(tx['household_key']).sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    normw = (112.0 / np.log(2.0)) * (1.0 - 0.5 ** (tenure / 112.0))
    out['dec112_rate'] = dec / normw.clip(lower=1e-6) * 7
    return out

def fn(view, s):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    g = tx.groupby('household_key')
    first = g['day'].min()
    tenure = (s - first).clip(lower=0)
    # windows
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=first.index)
    out['tenure_cap364'] = tenure.clip(upper=364)
    for W in (112, 182, 364):
        w = tx[(tx.day > s - W)]
        sp = w.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        out[f'rate_{W}'] = sp.reindex(out.index).fillna(0) / tenure.clip(lower=1).clip(upper=W)  # per-day rate within available window
    tr = tx[tx.day > s-364].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    out['trips_rate_364'] = tr.reindex(out.index).fillna(0) / (tenure.clip(lower=1).clip(upper=364)/7)  # trips per week
    # decayed spend halflife 112 normalized
    age = s - tx['day']
    wgt = 0.5 ** (age / 112.0)
    dec = (tx['sales_value'] * wgt).groupby(tx['household_key']).sum()
    # normalization: divide by sum of weights over available window
    # sum of weights over days d in [first, s] = sum_{a=0}^{tenure-1} 0.5^(a/112) ≈ 112/ln2 * (1 - 0.5^(tenure/112))
    normw = (112.0/np.log(2)) * (1 - 0.5**(tenure/112.0))
    out['dec112_rate'] = dec.reindex(out.index).fillna(0) / normw.clip(lower=1e-9)
    return out

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def fn(view, s):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name='household_key')  # view.households — is it a list/array or DataFrame? "view.households: the households needing a row at that snapshot". Probably an Index/array.
    first = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh)
    tenure = (s - first).astype(float)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    out['tenure_cap364'] = tenure.clip(upper=364)
    eff = tenure.clip(lower=1).clip(upper=364)
    for W in (112, 182, 364):
        w = tx[tx.day > s - W]
        sp = w.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        out[f'rate_{W}'] = sp / eff.clip(upper=W) * 7  # weekly-equivalent rate
    tr = tx[tx.day > s - 364].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['trips_rate_364'] = tr / (eff / 7.0)
    age = (s - tx['day']).astype(float)

    normw = (112.0 / np.log(2.0)) * (1.0 - 0.5 ** (tenure / 112.0))
    out['dec112_rate'] = dec / normw.clip(lower=1e-6) * 7

    df = df.copy()
    cat_cols = [c for c in df.columns if df[c].dtype == object or str(df[c].dtype)=='category' or df[c].dtype==bool]
    num = df.drop(columns=['household_key','snapshot_day'] + cat_cols)

        parts.append(d.values.astype(float))
    X = np.hstack(parts)

def ridge_fit(Xtr, ytr, lam):
    # standardize
    mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0); sd[sd==0]=1
    Z = (Xtr-mu)/sd
    A = Z.T@Z + lam*np.eye(Z.shape[1])
    b = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@ytr)
    return mu, sd, b
def ridge_pred(model, Xte):

    return ((Xte-mu)/sd)@b

def prep(df):
    df = df.copy()
    ycol = 'future_spend_4w'
    feat = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ('household_key','snapshot_day',ycol)]
    cat = [c for c in feat if df[c].dtype==object or str(df[c].dtype)=='category']
    num = [c for c in feat if c not in cat]
    Xn = df[num].astype(float).fillna(0.0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],0.0).values
    parts=[Xn]
    for c_ in cat:
        parts.append(pd.get_dummies(df[c_].fillna('NA').astype('category')).values.astype(float))
    return np.hstack(parts)

data = tt.merge(e013, on=['household_key','snapshot_day'], how='inner')
print("merged", data.shape)
X = prep(data)
y = data.future_spend_4w.values
snaps = sorted(data.snapshot_day.unique())
def ridge_cv(X, y, snaps, lams=(30,100,300,1000,3000), start=4):
    out={}
    for lam in lams:
        errs=[]
        for s in snaps[start:]:
            tr = data.snapshot_day.values < s
            te = data.snapshot_day.values == s
            Xtr, ytr = X[tr], y[tr]
            mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0); sd[sd==0]=1
            Z=(Xtr-mu)/sd
            A=Z.T@Z+lam*len(ytr)/len(ytr)*np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            ... lam scaling: use lam*n? Standard ridge: minimize ||y-Zw||^2 + lam*||w||^2; lam absolute. With standardized features and n~20k, lam ~ 100-3000 reasonable.
            w=np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@ytr)
            pred=((X[te]-mu)/sd)@w
            errs.append(np.mean(np.abs(pred-y[te])))
        out[lam]=np.mean(errs)
    return out
res = ridge_cv(X, y, snaps)
print("E013 ridge CV:", {k: round(v,2) for k,v in res.items()})
```

    b = {k: blk(k) for k in range(1, 9)}

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh_index)

def ridge_fit(Xtr, ytr, lam):
    # standardize
    mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0); sd[sd==0]=1
    Z = (Xtr-mu)/sd
    A = Z.T@Z + lam*np.eye(Z.shape[1])
    b = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@ytr)
    return mu, sd, b
def ridge_pred(model, Xte):
    mu, sd, b = model
    return ((Xte-mu)/sd)@b

    dm["disp"] = dm.display.astype(str).ne("0").astype(int)
    dm["mail"] = dm.mailer.astype(str).ne("0").astype(int)

    m["r28"] = m.day >= s - 27
    m["r84"] = m.day >= s - 83
    g = m.groupby("household_key").agg(

def fn(view, s):

def fn(view):
    day = view.day
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    base = agent_api.load_saved('e013_stationary.parquet')
    b = base[base.snapshot_day == day].set_index('household_key')
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name='household_key')  # view.households is? maybe list or Series
    tx = tx[tx.household_key.isin(hh)]
    tx['d'] = tx[['coupon_disc','coupon_match_disc','retail_disc']].fillna(0).clip(lower=0).sum(axis=1)
    g = tx.groupby('household_key')
    def win(sub, lo): return sub[sub.day >= day - lo + 1]  # window (day-lo, day]
    feats = {}
    for w,name in [(28,'28'),(84,'84'),(364,'364')]:
        s = tx[tx.day > day - w]
        feats[f'disc_{name}'] = s.groupby('household_key')['d'].sum()
    sp84 = tx[tx.day > day-84].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    feats['disc_rate_84'] = feats['disc_84']/(sp84+feats['disc_84']+1e-9)
    sp28 = tx[tx.day > day-28].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    feats['disc_rate_28'] = feats['disc_28']/(sp28+feats['disc_28']+1e-9)
    l84 = tx[tx.day > day-84]
    feats['line_disc_share_84'] = l84.assign(f=(l84['d']>0).astype(float)).groupby('household_key')['f'].mean()
    # trips
    trips = tx.drop_duplicates('basket_id')[['household_key','basket_id','day']]
    t84 = trips[trips.day > day-84]
    dow = t84['day'] % 7
    # entropy per household
    def ent(x):
        c = np.bincount(x, minlength=7); p = c[c>0]/c.sum(); return float(-(p*np.log(p)).sum())
    feats['trip_dow_entropy_84'] = t84.assign(dow=dow).groupby('household_key')['dow'].apply(ent)
    feats['trip_dow_top_share_84'] = t84.assign(dow=dow).groupby('household_key')['dow'].apply(lambda x: (np.bincount(x,minlength=7).max()/len(x)) if len(x) else np.nan)
    tt = tx[tx.day > day-84]
    morning = (tt.trans_time < 1200).astype(float); evening = (tt.trans_time >= 1700).astype(float)
    feats['morning_share_84'] = tt.assign(m=morning).groupby('household_key')['m'].mean()
    feats['evening_share_84'] = tt.assign(e=evening).groupby('household_key')['e'].mean()
    feats['time_std_84'] = tt.groupby('household_key')['trans_time'].std()
    q84 = tx[tx.day > day-84]
    feats['max_qty_84'] = q84.groupby('household_key')['quantity'].max()
    feats['bulk_share_84'] = q84.assign(b=(q84.quantity>=6).astype(float)).groupby('household_key')['b'].mean()
    ntrips28 = trips[trips.day > day-28].groupby('household_key').size()
    units28 = tx[tx.day > day-28].groupby('household_key')['quantity'].sum()
    feats['units_per_trip_28'] = units28/ntrips28
    X = pd.DataFrame(feats)
    out = b.join(X, how='left').reindex(hh)
    return out

def fn(view):
    day = view.day
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    base = agent_api.load_saved('e013_stationary.parquet')
    b = base[base.snapshot_day == day].set_index('household_key')
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name='household_key')  # view.households is? maybe list or Series
    tx = tx[tx.household_key.isin(hh)]
    tx['d'] = tx[['coupon_disc','coupon_match_disc','retail_disc']].fillna(0).clip(lower=0).sum(axis=1)
    g = tx.groupby('household_key')
    def win(sub, lo): return sub[sub.day >= day - lo + 1]  # window (day-lo, day]
    feats = {}
    for w,name in [(28,'28'),(84,'84'),(364,'364')]:
        s = tx[tx.day > day - w]
        feats[f'disc_{name}'] = s.groupby('household_key')['d'].sum()
    sp84 = tx[tx.day > day-84].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    feats['disc_rate_84'] = feats['disc_84']/(sp84+feats['disc_84']+1e-9)
    sp28 = tx[tx.day > day-28].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    feats['disc_rate_28'] = feats['disc_28']/(sp28+feats['disc_28']+1e-9)
    l84 = tx[tx.day > day-84]
    feats['line_disc_share_84'] = l84.assign(f=(l84['d']>0).astype(float)).groupby('household_key')['f'].mean()
    # trips
    trips = tx.drop_duplicates('basket_id')[['household_key','basket_id','day']]
    t84 = trips[trips.day > day-84]
    dow = t84['day'] % 7
    # entropy per household
    def ent(x):
        c = np.bincount(x, minlength=7); p = c[c>0]/c.sum(); return float(-(p*np.log(p)).sum())
    feats['trip_dow_entropy_84'] = t84.assign(dow=dow).groupby('household_key')['dow'].apply(ent)
    feats['trip_dow_top_share_84'] = t84.assign(dow=dow).groupby('household_key')['dow'].apply(lambda x: (np.bincount(x,minlength=7).max()/len(x)) if len(x) else np.nan)
    tt = tx[tx.day > day-84]
    morning = (tt.trans_time < 1200).astype(float); evening = (tt.trans_time >= 1700).astype(float)
    feats['morning_share_84'] = tt.assign(m=morning).groupby('household_key')['m'].mean()
    feats['evening_share_84'] = tt.assign(e=evening).groupby('household_key')['e'].mean()
    feats['time_std_84'] = tt.groupby('household_key')['trans_time'].std()
    q84 = tx[tx.day > day-84]
    feats['max_qty_84'] = q84.groupby('household_key')['quantity'].max()
    feats['bulk_share_84'] = q84.assign(b=(q84.quantity>=6).astype(float)).groupby('household_key')['b'].mean()
    ntrips28 = trips[trips.day > day-28].groupby('household_key').size()
    units28 = tx[tx.day > day-28].groupby('household_key')['quantity'].sum()
    feats['units_per_trip_28'] = units28/ntrips28
    X = pd.DataFrame(feats)
    out = b.join(X, how='left').reindex(hh)
    return out

def fit_pred(Xtr, ytr, Xte, lam):
    mu = np.nanmean(Xtr, 0); sd = np.nanstd(Xtr, 0); sd[sd==0]=1
    Z = np.where(np.isnan(Xtr), 0.0, (Xtr-mu)/sd)
    Zt = np.where(np.isnan(Xte), 0.0, (Xte-mu)/sd)
    Z = np.hstack([Z, np.ones((len(Z),1))]); Zt = np.hstack([Zt, np.ones((len(Zt),1))])
    d = Z.shape[1]
    A = Z.T@Z + lam*np.eye(d); A[-1,-1] -= lam  # don't penalize intercept... careful: lam*np.eye then subtract lam at intercept
    w = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@ytr)
    return Zt@w
```

df = agent_api.load_saved('e013_stationary.parquet')
tt = agent_api.train_targets()
m = df.merge(tt, on=['household_key','snapshot_day'], how='left')
feats = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ('household_key','snapshot_day')]
X = m[feats].copy()
obj_cols = [c for c in X.columns if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X[c])]
for c in obj_cols:
    d = pd.get_dummies(X[c].astype('object').where(X[c].notna(),'NA'), prefix=c)
    X = pd.concat([X.drop(columns=[c]), d.astype(float)], axis=1)
X = X.astype(float)
y = m['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(float)
day = m['snapshot_day'].values
tr = day < 459
Xv = X.values

# oof ridge
def fit_pred(Xtr, ytr, Xte, lam=10.0):
    mu = np.nanmean(Xtr,0); sd = np.nanstd(Xtr,0); sd = np.where(~np.isfinite(sd)|(sd==0),1.0,sd)
    Z = np.where(np.isfinite(Xtr),(Xtr-mu)/sd,0.0); Zt = np.where(np.isfinite(Xte),(Xte-mu)/sd,0.0)
    Z = np.hstack([Z,np.ones((len(Z),1))]); Zt = np.hstack([Zt,np.ones((len(Zt),1))])
    A = Z.T@Z + lam*np.eye(Z.shape[1]); A[-1,-1]-=lam
    w = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@ytr)
    return Zt@w

oof = np.full(len(y), np.nan)
tr_snaps = sorted(set(day[tr]))
for s in tr_snaps:
    te = tr & (day==s)
    oof[te] = fit_pred(Xv[tr & (day!=s)], y[tr & (day!=s)], Xv[te])
oof_val = fit_pred(Xv[tr], y[tr], Xv[~tr])
oof_full = np.where(tr, oof, oof_val)

def gbm_fit(binned_tr, ytr, rounds, lr=0.05, depth=2, lam=1.0, min_child=60,
            colsub=0.25, rowsub=0.75, seed=0, round_seeds=None, colsubs=None):
    n, p = binned_tr.shape
    F = np.zeros(n); base = ytr.mean(); F[:] = base
    trees = []
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    for r in range(rounds):
        g = F - ytr; h = np.ones(n)
        rs = rng.rand(n) < rowsub
        feats = rng.choice(p, max(4,int(p*colsub)), replace=False)
        root_idx = np.where(rs)[0]
        tree = build(binned_tr, g, h, root_idx, feats, depth, min_child, lam)
        upd = predict_tree(binned_tr, tree)
        F += lr*upd
        trees.append(tree)
    return base, trees

def build(binned, g, h, idx, feats, depth, min_child, lam):
    G, H = g[idx].sum(), h[idx].sum()
    node = {'idx_n': len(idx), 'leaf': None}
    if depth==0 or len(idx) < 2*min_child:
        node['leaf'] = -G/(H+lam); return node
    best = None
    for f in feats:
        b = binned[idx, f]
        gh = np.bincount(b, weights=g[idx], minlength=32)
        hh = np.bincount(b, minlength=32).astype(float)
        # cumulative splits
        Gl = np.cumsum(gh)[:-1]; Hl = np.cumsum(hh)[:-1]
        Gr = G-Gl; Hr = H-Hl
        gain = Gl*Gl/(Hl+lam) + Gr*Gr/(Hr+lam) - G*G/(H+lam)
        gain[Hl < min_child] = -1; gain[Hr < min_child] = -1
        j = gain.argmax()
        if gain[j] > 1e-9 and (best is None or gain[j] > best[0]):
            best = (gain[j], f, j)
    if best is None:
        node['leaf'] = -G/(H+lam); return node
    _, f, thr = best
    mask = binned[idx, f] <= thr
    node['f'] = f; node['thr'] = thr
    node['l'] = build(binned, g, h, idx[mask], feats, depth-1, min_child, lam)
    node['r'] = build(binned, g, h, idx[~mask], feats, depth-1, min_child, lam)
    return node
```

Note: bincount weights with float g — b is uint8 → fine. Note: hess = counts (squared loss). min_child on counts.

def predict_tree(binned, tree):
    out = np.zeros(len(binned))
    def rec(node, idx):
        if 'leaf' in node and node['leaf'] is not None:
            out[idx] = node['leaf']; return
        m = binned[idx, node['f']] <= node['thr']
        rec(node['l'], idx[m]); rec(node['r'], idx[~m])
    rec(tree, np.arange(len(binned)))
    return out
```

df = agent_api.load_saved('e013_stationary.parquet')
tt = agent_api.train_targets()
m = df.merge(tt, on=['household_key','snapshot_day'], how='left')
feats = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ('household_key','snapshot_day')]
X = m[feats].copy()
obj_cols = [c for c in X.columns if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X[c])]
for c in obj_cols:
    d = pd.get_dummies(X[c].astype('object').where(X[c].notna(),'NA'), prefix=c)
    X = pd.concat([X.drop(columns=[c]), d.astype(float)], axis=1)
X = X.astype(float)
y = m['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(float)
day = m['snapshot_day'].values
tr = day < 459
Xv = X.values

# oof ridge
def fit_pred(Xtr, ytr, Xte, lam=10.0):
    mu = np.nanmean(Xtr,0); sd = np.nanstd(Xtr,0); sd = np.where(~np.isfinite(sd)|(sd==0),1.0,sd)
    Z = np.where(np.isfinite(Xtr),(Xtr-mu)/sd,0.0); Zt = np.where(np.isfinite(Xte),(Xte-mu)/sd,0.0)
    Z = np.hstack([Z,np.ones((len(Z),1))]); Zt = np.hstack([Zt,np.ones((len(Zt),1))])
    A = Z.T@Z + lam*np.eye(Z.shape[1]); A[-1,-1]-=lam
    w = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@ytr)
    return Zt@w

oof = np.full(len(y), np.nan)
tr_snaps = sorted(set(day[tr]))
for s in tr_snaps:
    te = tr & (day==s)
    oof[te] = fit_pred(Xv[tr & (day!=s)], y[tr & (day!=s)], Xv[te])
oof_val = fit_pred(Xv[tr], y[tr], Xv[~tr])
oof_full = np.where(tr, oof, oof_val)

```python
def gbm_fit(binned_tr, ytr, rounds, lr=0.05, depth=2, lam=1.0, min_child=60,
            colsub=0.25, rowsub=0.75, seed=0, round_seeds=None, colsubs=None):
    n, p = binned_tr.shape
    F = np.zeros(n); base = ytr.mean(); F[:] = base
    trees = []
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    for r in range(rounds):
        g = F - ytr; h = np.ones(n)
        rs = rng.rand(n) < rowsub
        feats = rng.choice(p, max(4,int(p*colsub)), replace=False)
        root_idx = np.where(rs)[0]
        tree = build(binned_tr, g, h, root_idx, feats, depth, min_child, lam)
        upd = predict_tree(binned_tr, tree)
        F += lr*upd
        trees.append(tree)
    return base, trees

def build(binned, g, h, idx, feats, depth, min_child, lam):
    G, H = g[idx].sum(), h[idx].sum()
    node = {'idx_n': len(idx), 'leaf': None}
    if depth==0 or len(idx) < 2*min_child:
        node['leaf'] = -G/(H+lam); return node
    best = None
    for f in feats:
        b = binned[idx, f]
        gh = np.bincount(b, weights=g[idx], minlength=32)
        hh = np.bincount(b, minlength=32).astype(float)
        # cumulative splits
        Gl = np.cumsum(gh)[:-1]; Hl = np.cumsum(hh)[:-1]
        Gr = G-Gl; Hr = H-Hl
        gain = Gl*Gl/(Hl+lam) + Gr*Gr/(Hr+lam) - G*G/(H+lam)
        gain[Hl < min_child] = -1; gain[Hr < min_child] = -1
        j = gain.argmax()
        if gain[j] > 1e-9 and (best is None or gain[j] > best[0]):
            best = (gain[j], f, j)
    if best is None:
        node['leaf'] = -G/(H+lam); return node
    _, f, thr = best
    mask = binned[idx, f] <= thr
    node['f'] = f; node['thr'] = thr
    node['l'] = build(binned, g, h, idx[mask], feats, depth-1, min_child, lam)
    node['r'] = build(binned, g, h, idx[~mask], feats, depth-1, min_child, lam)
    return node
```

Note: bincount weights with float g — b is uint8 → fine. Note: hess = counts (squared loss). min_child on counts.

def predict_tree(binned, tree):
    out = np.zeros(len(binned))
    def rec(node, idx):
        if 'leaf' in node and node['leaf'] is not None:
            out[idx] = node['leaf']; return
        m = binned[idx, node['f']] <= node['thr']
        rec(node['l'], idx[m]); rec(node['r'], idx[~m])
    rec(tree, np.arange(len(binned)))
    return out
```

reasoning.reasoning:
Skew features: no gain on ridge proxy (64.100 → 64.136). The ridge proxy says no.

I've now tested three offline candidates: robust medians (no), stacking (no), skew (no). I have 10 tool calls used since last experiment; 5 remain before I must call the experiment (the rule: between two experiments at most 15 other tool calls).

What else could plausibly help the fixed model, given the proxy can't see tree interactions? Let me think about what the fixed model (likely gradient boosting) might exploit that my ridge proxy can't measure:

1. **Interactions/categorical splits**: trees can split on features. My ridge proxy is linear — a feature that's useful only via interaction/split would show no ridge gain but could help trees. But E016/E014 evidence suggests the harness model ≈ ridge-like in its response to features... Actually E016 added 19 features and MAE went 60.788→65.334 (+4.5), while ridge proxy would have shown a much smaller delta presumably. Hmm, that's a big jump — maybe the harness model overfits new noisy features (display features are noisy). This suggests the harness model is a flexible learner (trees) that overfits noisy additions. So adding noisy features is risky; the ridge proxy underestimates harm.

2. Given that, the safest final experiment is one that *removes* risky columns from E013 rather than adds. E015 (E013 minus 14 cols) was worse (60.944). E013 = E011 minus 19 drifting cols. What about removing remaining weak/noisy columns? E013 has 80 features. Which are likely noise? The demographic codes (age_code, class3_code, size_code, class5_code, homeowner_code, kids_code, class2, has_demo, redemp_84 — these have 89–97% NaN!). The fixed model handles NaN, but 89% NaN features with mostly-constant codes could create noisy splits. E004 (which added demographics on top of E002) improved slightly (61.401→61.237), so demographics helped then. But E013 kept them.

Actually wait — E015 dropped homeowner_code, age_code, class3_code, has_demo among its 14 removed columns and got worse (60.944 vs 60.788). So demographics are mildly useful, not harmful.

3. **Feature: target-like aligned lag at s+? No — can't use future.**

4. What about the **zero-inflation structure**: 20.7% of targets are 0. A tree model benefits from a strong "P(zero)" feature. E006 added zero-block share features. E013 has z_zero_block_share, z_notrip28_x_rate, no_trip_28/56, sk-like zero shares aren't in E013. Hmm, E013 has no_trip_28, no_trip_56, z_zero_block_share, zero_streak_wk.

5. **Per-snapshot calibration feature**: The distribution of spend drifts over time (mean_y by snapshot: 130→146). A feature = snapshot day index (trend) was dropped in E013 because it drifted... wait, E013 dropped 'trend' and 'week' etc. as "drifting out of training range". But validation snapshots 459–543 are within the range of train snapshots 95–431 extended... The dropped columns were ones whose *values* at validation exceed training ranges (e.g., tenure grows monotonically). But snapshot_day itself: validation days 459–543 vs train 95–431 — also out of range! Yet E000 included snapshot day index and E013's parent E011 included 'week', 'week_q', 'trend'... E013 dropped them and improved. OK.

6. **Better idea — think about what actually drives MAE**: With 20.7% zeros and heavy tail, the fixed model's predictions on low rows matter. Decile 0: MAE 17.6, oracle shift −8.8. Deciles 1–7 want −14 to −21 shifts. A global 0.95 scale gave 63.66 (−0.44). Per-decile oracle gave −2.07. If the harness model is trees, it can already produce per-decile shifts *if features identify them*. The residual median pattern by predicted-decile is learnable from the same features (it's a function of p, which is a function of features). Trees with enough depth can learn "when predicted level is X, output median not mean". The harness model apparently doesn't fully. Could a feature like `sk_blk_med` (historical median of aligned 4-week blocks) help trees do that? Ridge says no, but trees could use it as a split to branch into "median-like" predictions. Hmm.

But E017 (spike/reversion features) tested exactly this idea and gave +0.02 (neutral). And E014 (seasonal lags) hurt. The evidence: feature additions on top of E013 are neutral-to-harmful for the harness model.

7. **Alternative: improve the base signal quality rather than add features.** E013's strongest features are dec_28 (exp-decayed spend). What about *replacing* noisy features with cleaner versions? E013 has 'spend_cur_wk', 'spend_7', 'z_dec_7' — very short windows, noisy. E015 dropped some long-window features and got worse; short-window features weren't tested for removal.

8. **What about a two-model-style feature: the harness model itself?** Stacking the ridge OOF into E013 — ridge OOF is 0.99 corr with dec_28, useless.

9. **Prediction clipping/monotone transform of existing features**: E008 tested log1p on E006's features — neutral (60.953 vs 60.931). 

10. **Duplicate-row insight**: E003 failed with "499058 duplicate (household_key, snapshot_day) rows" — that was a join bug, not informative.

11. **Household-level aggregation across snapshots**: For each (household, snapshot), the household appears at multiple snapshots (every 28 days). The *previous snapshot's target* (future_spend_4w at s−28) equals spend in [s−27, s] — which is exactly lag1 block spend, computable from transactions alone (E007 added aligned-block lags: neutral, 60.991 vs 60.931). So that's covered.

12. **What about the *test* period consideration?** No, evaluation is validation only.

13. **Hyperparameter-free idea: drop the 'class2' categorical + other remaining weak columns and add nothing.** E015 tried dropping 14 and got worse. Dropping different columns might help, but expected effect is small (±0.1).

14. **Think about the biggest structural miss: the fixed model trains on ALL train rows pooled across snapshots.** Feature drift: E013 already removed drifting features. What about *normalizing* features per snapshot (rank/z within snapshot)? That makes train and validation distributions aligned. E013 has 'z_' prefixed features (z_dec_7, z_dec_224, z_trips_14, ...) — those are already within-household z-scores (household-normalized), not snapshot-normalized. Snapshot-level normalization (cross-sectional rank within snapshot) would make features stationary across snapshots. E.g., rank of dec_28 within its snapshot. Trees split on absolute values; ranks change the split semantics but could improve transfer to validation snapshots if the level distribution drifts. Does the level distribution drift? mean_y by snapshot: 130, 124, 132, 127, 130, 140, 139, 137, 139, 137, 138, 147, 141 — mild upward drift (~+8% from early to late). Validation mean presumably similar (~140). dec_28 distribution likely drifts similarly. A cross-sectional rank feature is invariant to that drift. This is a genuinely different transformation not yet tested! E008 tested log (global monotone, doesn't remove drift); ranks remove drift entirely.

But wait — would rank features help trees? Trees on ranks = trees on quantile-binned levels; equivalent to trees on original values with different split points. If the relationship y~f(level) is stable but the level distribution shifts, ranks lose information (within-snapshot rank conflates). Hmm, actually if f is monotone, rank preserves ordering within snapshot; trees can learn f on rank scale and it transfers perfectly across snapshots. This could be a real gain if drift matters. But the drift seems mild (~8%).

Let me quantify drift: distribution of dec_28 across train snapshots vs validation snapshots. I can compute dec_28 at validation snapshots from the saved E013 table (it has features at validation rows, just no targets). Compare quantiles of dec_28 at snap 431 (last train) vs 459/487/515/543 (validation). If similar → drift is not the issue. If shifted → rank features could help.

Also check: mean of dec_28 by snapshot across train — trend?

Let me do that quickly. Also consider **household tenure/age at snapshot**: households enter the panel at different times; at later snapshots the mix shifts (more mature households). E013 dropped tenure.
